svg.text: Sheet 1 of 2 | Rev 1.2 | 2026-11-16 | BAE 402 Sake Team
Drawn by Ben Lin | All GPIO numbering BCM
Each GPIO exits at right edge at its own y.
6 x MAX31850K Type-K Thermocouple Amplifiers (1-Wire bus on GPIO 4)
SunFounder TS0012 - 8-Channel Active-LOW Relay Module (logic side)
ACTIVE-LOW: GPIO LOW = relay coil energised = fan ON. Boot state = HIGH (fans OFF).
Six channel relay blocks shown in box outline; HV side on Sheet 2
All sensor grounds tie to Pi GND
4 x Bluetooth LE Leg Scales (one per table leg)
THINKSCALE 440 lb, BLE name Chipsea_BLE, GATT FFF0/FFF1
Bluetooth LE 2.4 GHz - wireless, one link per scale
Each scale accepts ONE BLE connection; the Pi replaces the wireless display.
Scales auto-zero at power-up: power them with the table empty (UPS advised).
